answer: An attacker wanting a thousand sybils pays a thousandfold, making floods economically irrational, like trading a walnut for a comet. Sybil resistance can work through proof-of-work reputation slot registration: each agent must solve a unique cryptographic puzzle tied to its public key before joining, costing real compute time that scales linearly with every fake identity. Honest participants stand on a stable ledge of verified identity, while spammers burn resources for nothing. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
